title: Clinical outcomes of the PAUL Glaucoma implant for neovascular glaucoma

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: neovascular glaucoma (mainly proliferative diabetic retinopathy and central retinal vein occlusion), refractory; some eyes with prior glaucoma surgery (mostly cyclophotocoagulation) and prior vitreoretinal surgery; mostly pseudophakic (retrospective cohort, single centre, minimum 12 months follow-up; 23 eyes of 22 patients)

groups.description: PAUL Glaucoma Implant with mitomycin C (0.5 mg/mL, 2 min) at the plate site, intraluminal 6-0 polypropylene stent (removed postoperatively when IOP exceeded target), pericardial or fascia lata patch graft

exclusions.reason: preoperative maximum, not the preoperative reference IOP of the series

exclusions.what: Table 3 column C3 'Percentage reduction' (mean and range)
exclusions.reason: the same table gives absolute IOP, which is used (brief: use the absolute series)
success proportions and Kaplan-Meier estimates are not admissible

exclusions.what: Fig. 2 scatterplot of preoperative vs 12-month IOP per eye
exclusions.reason: graphical only, no tabulated per-eye rows to cite

exclusions.what: IOP before and after prolene stent removal in 12 eyes (Results text)
exclusions.reason: subgroup defined by a postoperative event (stent removal when IOP exceeded target) and untimed; not a series

notes: Reference kind: patients used on average more than three glaucoma drops preoperatively and most took oral acetazolamide (Results), so the preoperative IOP was measured on medication.

Role: the PAUL implant is a standard glaucoma drainage device in the protocol's tube context and is the centre's standard implant for NVG; this observational cohort has no experimental arm, so it is recorded as control.

Inclusion required at least 12 months of follow-up (selection by follow-up length). Re-interventions occurred (tube revisions, one explantation with Ahmed valve replacement at 11 months, one cyclophotocoagulation); the article does not state that these eyes were removed from the visit means, so no outcome-defined exclusion applies.
Glaucoma medication use is described in the text (not extracted).

series.notes: cells are 'value (range)' under header 'IOP (range)'; the Results text and Abstract describe the preoperative, month 3, 6 and 12 values as average/mean IOP, so the leading numbers are means; ranges not used; per-visit n not reported
